title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
abstract: arXiv:2611.32063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear attention replaces softmax attention with a linear formulation, enabling linear-time computation with a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value cache. These computational and memory advantages have attracted growing interest in linear attention for long-context language modeling. However, compressing past information into a fixed-size state causes memory collisions that hinder long-context understanding. Although DeltaNet mitigates memory collisions through delta-rule updates and Gated DeltaNet extends this approach with gating, these mechanisms may also discard information relevant to future predictions. To address this limitation, we introduce Integral DeltaNet, which maintains two complementary recurrent states: a fast-updating delta state that captures current key-value associations and an integral state that preserves a weighted history of the delta state. translated_title: Integral DeltaNet：基于自适应记忆积分的改进线性注意力
translated_abstract: 线性注意力用线性形式替代softmax注意力，实现线性时间计算，并用固定大小的循环状态取代不断增长的键值缓存。这些计算与内存优势使线性注意力在长上下文语言建模中受到越来越多的关注。然而，将过去信息压缩到固定大小的状态中会造成记忆冲突，阻碍长上下文理解。尽管DeltaNet通过delta规则更新缓解了记忆冲突，Gated DeltaNet进一步引入门控机制加以扩展，但这些机制也可能丢弃对未来预测有用的信息。为解决这一局限，我们提出Integral DeltaNet，它维护两个互补的循环状态：一个快速更新的delta状态，用于捕获当前的键值关联；以及一个积分状态，用于保存delta状态的加权历史。在读取时，模型自适应地结合这些状态。
tldr: Integral DeltaNet通过同时维护快速更新的delta状态和保留其加权历史的积分状态这两个互补记忆，并在读取时自适应地融合二者，从而在缓解线性注意力记忆冲突的同时保留对未来预测有用的历史信息。
en_tdlr: Integral DeltaNet maintains two complementary recurrent states—a fast-updating delta state and an integral state preserving its weighted history—and adaptively combines them at readout, mitigating memory collisions in linear attention while retaining information useful for future predictions.
